comment: The panel prints P and G beside the two input jacks and again beside the two output jacks, and POLY under the channel-count knob; the switch and the Note Removed jack carry no lettering. The maker's manual says the note is transposed by octaves; src/Notable.cpp:179-184 moves it by (int)abs(max-min) volts instead, with a floor of 1, so it is an octave only when the two knobs are set exactly one volt apart. The module's own right-click menu also carries an unreadable first item: src/Notable.cpp:255-257 casts the raw bytes of the pitch memory to a string and adds it as a menu entry, which is debugging left in.
